title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality-gating improvements
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: improve our per-prompt regression checks so PRs trigger targeted quality gates and surface eval metrics in CI. This change adds a lightweight CI hook that runs the eval-harness on a changed prompt-set subset, publishes per-prompt metrics to the CI job summary, and fails only when configured thresholds (precision/regression) are exceeded. The approach minimizes CI cost by sharding evaluation to the changed files and reusing cached baselines. Changes include: a new GitHub Actions job `eval-per-prompt` that detects changed prompt-sets, a small Python runner wrapper that invokes existing eval-harness APIs, standardized JSON artifact output for per-prompt metrics, and integration with the CI annotation API to show failing prompts inline. The PR also tightens the default quality-gate rules (warn -> fail for >2% absolute regression on top-level prompt groups) and adds a toggle to mark a prompt-set as experimental so it is excluded from strict gating. Checklist: - [x] Add eval-per-prompt GH Action and matrix sharding - [x] Implement prompt-diff detection and baseline caching - [x] Emit standardized artifacts (per_prompt_metrics.json) - [x] Wire CI annotations and job summary - [x] Add unit/integration tests for runner wrapper - [x] Update docs and runbook references (docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md) Backwards compatibility: existing eval-harness CLI remains unchanged; new runner wraps it and reuses existing config. For enterprise/private deployments the CI hook is optional and disabled by default (configurable via repo-level eval config).

release_notes:
- Add eval-per-prompt GitHub Action to run targeted prompt-set regressions in CI.
- Emit standardized per_prompt_metrics.json artifact and CI annotations.
- Tighten default quality gates for prompt regressions (warn -> fail for >2% absolute regression).
- Add experimental prompt-set toggle to opt-out of strict gating.
manual_steps: To enable per-repo: add `eval: { per_prompt_ci: enabled }` to .evalconfig; see docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md. Ensure baseline artifacts exist in `ci-cache/eval-baselines/` for fast runs.
notes_for_release_manager: Feature is opt-in; no migration needed. Notify infra about potential temporary increase in GH Action runners when enabling across many repos.
rerun_instructions: If a job fails due to external API flakiness, re-run the `eval-per-prompt` job via GitHub UI; runner includes 3 automatic retries for flaky evals.
